Several performers (likely female vocalists/dancers) are visible in the center and right, wearing light-colored costumes. The background is dark with visible stage lighting rigs and haze. In the bottom left corner, there is blurry white text overlay.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a string of white characters in the bottom-left corner that resembles a watermark or timestamp but is illegible and distorted, typical of AI generation or low-quality compression artifacts.

Significant motion blur and 'smearing' are present on the legs and arms of the central figures. While this could be motion blur from photography, the edges blend into the background in a way that suggests generative smoothing rather than optical blur.

The feet and lower legs of the central figure appear to merge with the floor and each other. The anatomy is indistinct, lacking clear definition of shoes or individual toes, appearing as melted stumps.
